risk_flags.description: The contract explicitly excludes migration changes, which could leave older or migrated expense records with the old pre-converted USD behavior. If reports read migrated data, this may fail the requester's goal that conversion happens when the report runs.
risk_flags.span: The v1→v2 migration logic in `store.migrate` is not changed

risk_flags.description: Removing `normalize()` entirely may drop non-currency-conversion behavior such as validation or currency formatting, if that function does more than USD conversion. The contract should confirm that only immediate USD conversion is removed.
risk_flags.span: `store.add_expense` no longer calls `normalize()` or `to_usd()` at write time

verdict.primary_risk: The migration exclusion may preserve old pre-converted USD data paths, so reports could still show wrong EUR expenses for migrated or existing records.
